title: alangium villosum subsp. pilosum
intro: Alangium villosum subsp. pilosum, commonly known as the Himalayan Sweet Flower, is a plant species belonging to the family Alangiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Alangium villosum subsp. pilosum include its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, as well as its potential in wound healing and immune system modulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
